channel.title: Shubham Sahu — latest work
channel.description: Project releases and build notes from Shubham Sahu.

item.title: NO SUS 1.1.8: links that open, and sharing across screens.
item.description: The current Android release improves link opening, accessible web controls and photo recovery. The 1.1 series follows the earlier 1.7 and 1.8 builds after a version-number reset.

item.title: SURANG-SUTRA: checking the cage and puck exit before fabrication.
item.description: The Stage 2 repository now includes a parametric FreeCAD assembly, STEP/STL exports, clearance checks and cage-impact analysis.

item.title: SURANG-SUTRA design files and a refreshed robotics resume.
item.description: My Embedded Robotics resume now covers SURANG-SUTRA, a mine-rescue scout and relay-puck design shortlisted for Stage 2 of the Vishwakarma Awards 2026-27.

item.title: Canary: public Solana devnet receipts, with clear limits.
item.description: The public repository documents seal and open receipts on Solana devnet, alongside a recorded demo and the security model.

item.title: Mumbai Event Radar: one view of local tech meetups.
item.description: A small browser tool collects free, in-person Mumbai tech listings from Luma, with filters and links back to each original event.

item.title: NO SUS 1.7.1: a focused Android app and a better PDF reader.
item.description: The Android release improves shared-document viewing, simplifies Send, and removes earlier experimental features, including the Web3 zone.

item.title: NO SUS 1.6.0: a new app design and Web3 zone.
item.description: This earlier Android release introduced a monochrome interface and a Canary experiment in the Web3 zone. The Web3 zone was removed in 1.7.1 on 14 October.

item.title: Packet Quest: learn networking one question at a time.
item.description: My browser study game turns Computer Networks revision into visual lessons, active-recall challenges, and exam-answer practice.

item.title: Making privacy easier to explain.
item.description: I’m sharing short NO SUS demos and privacy stories on Instagram, connecting the product to everyday file-sharing habits.

item.title: NO SUS 1.5.6: clearer Drop addresses.
item.description: The 8 October Android release improved Drop receiving addresses. This is a historical note: the Android receive-address feature was removed in 1.7.1 on 14 October.

item.title: A project page should show its current state.
item.description: My latest portfolio note explains why live interfaces, hardware prototypes, and disconnected demos deserve clear labels.

item.title: Test one servo before debugging the gait.
item.description: My Aurigen C3 Rover build note starts with a small diagnostic for the ESP32-C3 and four SG90 servos.
